item.title: Livelihood, education goals affect migration under climate change
item.description:
Waypoint is curating and commenting on third-party reporting. Original publisher: Phys.org.
Summary: Climate-driven hazards can push many to leave their homes in search of a livelihood elsewhere, but aspirations for the future may change where they decide to migrate, according to a new study led by researchers at Penn State.
